During the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''droid factory''' on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Karagga]]. The factory was protected by the [[Kintan crusher]] [[Foreman Crusher]].
